conservative.read: This conservative plan targets around 1.5% per month, focusing on capital preservation and low drawdown. It significantly reduces risk by eliminating all leveraged ETFs and high-beta names. Expect lower volatility but also more modest growth potential.

balanced.read: This balanced plan targets around 2.5% per month, aiming for risk-first growth. It reduces overall leverage and concentration while maintaining exposure to quality tech and broad markets. Expect moderate volatility and growth potential.

aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets around 4% per month, aiming for stretch growth. It utilizes and adds to leveraged ETFs and concentrates in high-scoring scanner setups. Be aware this mode carries significantly higher drawdown risk and daily decay from leveraged ETFs, requiring strict stop discipline.

income.read: This income plan targets around 1% per month, focusing on parking cash for yield. It rotates into income/covered-call ETFs and broad index for steady distributions, cutting leverage and high-beta names. Distributions are variable, and NAV can still fall in selloffs; this is cash-like income, not a savings account.
